properties.first query:
SELECT
    accessed_date,
    duration_secs,
    CASE network_protocol
    	WHEN 'ICMP ' THEN 0
	    WHEN 'HTTP' THEN 1
    	WHEN 'TCP  ' THEN 2
	    WHEN 'HTTP  ' THEN 3
	    WHEN 'UDP  ' THEN 4
        ELSE -1
    END AS network_protocol,
    TRIM(BOTH ' ' FROM ip) AS ip_address,
    bytes,
    CASE accessed_from
        WHEN 'Safari' THEN 0
        WHEN 'SafFRi' THEN 0
        WHEN 'Mozilla Firefox' THEN 1
        WHEN 'IOS App' THEN 2
        WHEN 'Others' THEN 3
        WHEN 'Microsoft Edge' THEN 3
        WHEN 'Chrome' THEN 4
        WHEN 'Android App' THEN 5
        ELSE -1
    END AS accessed_from,
    CASE gender
        WHEN 'Unknown' THEN 0
        WHEN 'Male' THEN 1
        WHEN 'Female' THEN 2
        ELSE -1
    END AS gender,
    CASE country
        WHEN 'FR' THEN 0
        WHEN 'CA' THEN 1
        WHEN 'DK' THEN 2
        WHEN 'MX' THEN 3
        WHEN 'US' THEN 4
        WHEN 'IE' THEN 5
        WHEN 'AT' THEN 6
        WHEN 'FI' THEN 7
        WHEN 'IT' THEN 8
        WHEN 'IN' THEN 9
        WHEN 'CO' THEN 10
        WHEN 'NO' THEN 11
        WHEN 'KR' THEN 12
        WHEN 'PL' THEN 13
        WHEN 'ZA' THEN 14
        WHEN 'CN' THEN 15
        WHEN 'RU' THEN 16
        WHEN 'DE' THEN 17
        WHEN 'CH' THEN 18
        WHEN 'PR' THEN 19
        WHEN 'AU' THEN 20
        WHEN 'SE' THEN 21
        WHEN 'AR' THEN 22
        WHEN 'JP' THEN 23
        WHEN 'PE' THEN 24
        WHEN 'AE' THEN 25
        WHEN 'GB' THEN 26
        ELSE -1
    END AS country,
    CASE membership
        WHEN 'Premium' THEN 2
        WHEN 'Normal' THEN 1
        WHEN 'Not Logged In' THEN 0
        ELSE -1
    END AS membership,
    CASE language_in_log
	    WHEN 'Slovak' THEN 0
        WHEN 'Russian' THEN 1
        WHEN 'swahili' THEN 2
        WHEN 'Spanish' THEN 3
        WHEN 'polish' THEN 4
        WHEN 'serbian' THEN 5
        WHEN 'Italian' THEN 6
        WHEN 'italian' THEN 6
        WHEN 'marathi' THEN 7
        WHEN 'slovene' THEN 8
        WHEN 'romanian' THEN 9
        WHEN 'urdu' THEN 10
        WHEN 'Portuguese' THEN 11
        WHEN 'Thai' THEN 12
        WHEN 'mongolian' THEN 13
        WHEN 'English' THEN 14
        WHEN 'persian' THEN 15
        WHEN 'macedonian' THEN 16
        WHEN 'tegulu' THEN 17
        WHEN 'swedish' THEN 18
        WHEN 'norwegian' THEN 19
        WHEN 'Japanese' THEN 20
        WHEN 'German' THEN 21
        WHEN 'Chinese' THEN 22
        WHEN 'Dutch' THEN 23
        WHEN 'French' THEN 24
        WHEN 'Arabic' THEN 25
        WHEN 'nepali' THEN 26
        WHEN 'malay' THEN 27
        WHEN 'malayalam' THEN 28
        ELSE -1
    END AS language_in_log,
    sales,
    CASE returned
    	WHEN 'Yes' THEN 1
	    WHEN 'No' THEN 0
        ELSE -1
    END AS returned,
    returned_amount,
    CASE pay_method
        WHEN 'Credit Card' THEN 0
        WHEN 'Debit Card' THEN 1
        WHEN 'Others' THEN 2
        WHEN 'Cash' THEN 3
        ELSE -1
    END AS pay_method
FROM FLOWFILE

processors.name: Convert Accessed Date Attr to Date Data Type

properties.another query:
SELECT
	ROW_NUMBER() OVER() AS id,
	accessed_date,
    CAST(FLOOR(MOD(CAST(accessed_date AS BIGINT) / 86400000, 31) + 1) AS INTEGER) AS epc_day_of_month,
    CAST(FLOOR(MOD(CAST(accessed_date AS BIGINT) / 2678400000, 12) + 1) AS INTEGER) AS epc_month_of_year,
    CAST(FLOOR(CAST(accessed_date AS BIGINT) / 31536000000) + 1970 AS INTEGER) AS epc_year,
    CAST(FLOOR(MOD(CAST(accessed_date AS BIGINT) / 7776000000, 4) + 1) AS INTEGER) AS epc_quarter,
    CAST(MOD(FLOOR(CAST(accessed_date AS BIGINT) / 86400000) + 4, 7) + 1 AS INTEGER) AS epc_day_of_week,
    CAST(FLOOR((CAST(accessed_date AS BIGINT) / 86400000 + 4) / 7) AS INTEGER) AS epc_week_of_year,
	duration_secs,
    network_protocol,
    TRIM(BOTH ' ' FROM ip_address) AS ip_address,
    bytes,
    accessed_from,
    gender,
    country,
    membership,
    language_in_log,
    sales,
    returned,
    returned_amount,
    pay_method AS payment_method
FROM FLOWFILE
